purpose: wiring integrity for the session-insights aggregate/report pipeline: synthetic Claude Code/Codex/zcode stores are built at check time inside a temporary directory, the CLI runs as a subprocess against them, golden aggregates pin the metric semantics, and privacy plus fail-closed negative controls prove redaction and unsupported holds

fixtures.note: No fixture bytes are checked in; the store (including secret-shaped seeds) exists only inside a tempfile.TemporaryDirectory during check.

claude_code_sessions.role: baseline session: two turns, Read/Bash tool calls, one isApiErrorMessage error, one malformed line, one isMeta line, one bookkeeping summary line, one tool_result-only user record
friction session: two interruption markers, one truthy error field, one Bash call
skipped-subagent session: every line carries isSidechain true
newest session, repeats the shared first prompt, anchors the window at 2026-09-09T18:05:00Z
stale session at 2026-08-01: trimmed by the default 30-day window, included at --days 60
privacy session: first prompt over 200 chars embedding the absolute home path and secret-shaped seeds (sk-, ghp_, AKIA, AIza, PEM marker)

codex: sessions/2026/09/01/rollout-2026-09-01T00-00-00-aaaaaaaa.jsonl (present and detectable; adapter must fail closed)
zcode: v2/sessions/deadbeefworkspace/claude-import-0123456789abcdef01234567.json (present and detectable; adapter must fail closed)

goldens: GOLDEN_AGGREGATE in benchmark.py pins the full claude-code aggregate section except the mtime-dependent composite digest

cache checks (#167): excerpts-off aggregate writes session-insights.metadata-cache.v1 under the invoking cwd's .azhou namespace; warm, deleted, and corrupt cache states return output byte-identical to the cold run; changed, added, and removed session files re-scan; cache bytes carry no transcript text (first prompts survive only as SHA-256), no encoded project directory names, and no absolute home path; excerpts-on runs bypass the cache

roast tone checks (#164): --tone roast renders an added presentation-only section; stripping it restores the machine body byte-identically; every roast line cites at least one statistic and every cited value appears verbatim in the machine body; receipt machine fields are equal across tones; the default tone renders no roast section

offline HTML checks (#165): --format html renders a self-contained single file (doctype, inlined CSS, no script, no external resource markers, closed document, print-friendly footer); every markdown bullet fact appears as the matching list item in the HTML artifact; privacy scans and the fixed footer cover the HTML form; receipt machine fields are equal across formats
